name: The RPG Mines - Otherworldly[0.92beta]
desc:
Do not macro, abuse game breaking bugs or play on more than 1 account at once. Punishments may vary from a temporary ban to a permanent ban!
NOTICE : This game contains loud sounds and flashing lights. Beware!

Current Version : 1.3 - Pale Palace Of Nil Update
Current Patch : 1.3

RPG Mines is a mining game where your goal is to get extremely rare ores. They can range from 30 to billions.
There's a lot of equipment you can craft throughout your journey!
Will you get everything?
Good luck!

[There is an In-Game guide helping with progression / known questions]
